question: What is the meaning of depth in relation to geometry?
description: Depth refers to the third dimension of geometry, indicating the height or vertical extent of a product. It is one of the three dimensions (length, width, and height) used to describe the geometry of a product. In the context of Building Information Modeling (BIM), depth is an important attribute for defining the shape and size of building components. It is used to specify the vertical dimensions of a product, which can be crucial for understanding its spatial requirements and for planning the construction process. In the provided text, depth is mentioned as a dimension alongside length and width, which are used to define the geometry of products in the digital product passport (DPP) framework.
